column1: #  - sub NAME is a function wherever it is written: at file level, after a `package` statement, inside a `package NAME { }` block. Perl has no methods as a syntax form; a sub called through `$self->` is still a sub. A prototype or attribute list changes nothing;
#  - package NAME (statement or block form) is a package;
#  - `use constant NAME => value` and every key of `use constant { A => 1, B => 2 }` are constants. Constant values must not be bare words (a bare-word value is read as a key);
#  - `our $x`, `our @x`, `our %x` and `our ($a, $b)` at file level or directly inside a package block are variables;
#  - `my` variables, anonymous subs, `local`, calls and `use`/`require` of modules are not definitions.
